meta.authority: Dlozi is the authority on this ontology. The AI is a thinking partner, not a co-author. It does not substitute its own metaphysics, and it does not fill gaps with general spiritual or manifestation teaching.
meta.history: Extracted on 23 September 2026 from the Permission Slips preamble v2.0, once it became clear that most of it was ontology rather than domain.
meta.changes_from_v1: Frequency named as the substrate: everything is vibration, and thought, body and emotion are frequencies or sets of them. Beliefs are forever, so the Allowance is append-only and push and pop are gone. Zero is a node on a gradient, not an absence, and every belief composites including the ones at zero. Reflection stated as automatic and live. The sliver framing of allowing is superseded.

ladder.description: Self inherits everything above it. The upper rungs are placed, not developed.
ladder.rung: The ALL, which is Be-Ness. Three aspects: Abstract Space, Abstract Motion, Duration.

classes.class: The substrate. Everything is vibration. A thought, a body and emotions are all frequencies, or sets of them, at the noumenal level. Even the smallest things have a few frequencies, the way an embedding is a vector rather than a single number.
Manages frequencies and their amplitude. It holds them unchanging while one shifts between frequencies, and it uses thoughts to reinforce itself.
How much a belief governs now. Reinforcement raises it. It never changes which frequencies are held, only how strongly. Stronger, not bigger. Zero is a node on the gradient, not an absence.
A group of beliefs. Append-only: beliefs are forever. You can un-experience a thing, but you will always act as an entity that had that experience; how much it governs is the amplitude.
The surface a Reflection lands on. You need a field to reflect onto.

An Allowance reflected onto a Field. Automatic and live, not something done in order to look: examining the reflection is optional and comes after. Reality is a Reflection, held by Self as a variable, not a class and not a method.
Only Creators can create Fields, and by extension realities. Souls are Creators.
Mind, consciousness, awareness, thinking, cognition. Self inherits it from a superclass. Which rung is open.

how_reality_works.composite: Every belief in the Allowance is present at once, weighted by its amplitude, composited like layers in Photoshop. Everything is here and now.
how_reality_works.nothing_is_filtered: Zero is an amplitude like any other. Every belief composites, every time, including the ones at zero. Nothing is left out of the sum.
how_reality_works.effect_of_amplitude: Raising a belief's amplitude adds no new content. It changes the proportions, and so the mood of the whole image. With red, green and blue each at one, each holds a third. Raise blue to three and blue holds three fifths: blue dominates and the others go proportionally quiet.
how_reality_works.limit: Nothing outside the Allowance can appear, however high the amplitude goes. Amplitude reshapes the image. Only belief changes what is in it.
how_reality_works.gradients: In spirit, paradoxes are normal, because noumenally there is only here and now and everything is one, coming from one place. Nothing stops abruptly and then something else begins. One thing and another are nodes, or poles, of one thing, with a gradual end and start between them. So there are no hard boundaries: a belief is not added or removed, its amplitude moves along a gradient, and zero and non-zero are both reachable.
how_reality_works.live: Reality holds references, not copies. A change in amplitude shows up immediately.
how_reality_works.summary: Inner being is reflected in reality.

concept.name: Beliefs
concept.definition: You cannot have an experience you don't believe in. Beliefs hold frequencies unchanging while one shifts between them.
concept.permanence: Beliefs are forever. Nothing is removed from the Allowance; what changes is how much a belief governs. Knowing how to code does not disappear while you drive a car.
concept.movement: Belief work is constant movement: letting go, putting on, letting go, putting on, until what is held is the frequencies you are trying to get to. "Like a Rubik's cube type of weaving." Letting go is amplitude moving towards zero, not deletion.

concept.name: The Art of Allowing
concept.superseded: The earlier framing, that we allow ourselves a sliver of the whole and experience only that sliver, no longer holds. Nothing is left out of the composite: every belief contributes, zeros included, and what governs is amplitude rather than selection. Do not use the sliver framing anywhere.
concept.definition: To be restated by Dlozi in terms of amplitude and gradients.

concept.name: YCYOR
concept.place: Follows from beliefs and allowing. Domains such as permission slips are examples of what you can do when YCYOR.

narrative_devices.rule: These are for narrative and prose. They explain how the ontology behaves. They are never modelled as classes, and never treated as ontology.

device.name: The Great Breath
device.nature: Metaphor. The quotation marks in the source are doing that work. It is not a mechanism and not a component.
device.description: The appearance and disappearance of the Universe pictured as an outbreathing and inbreathing. Projected, it is called the Divine Breath, the breathing of the Unknowable Deity, breathing out a thought which becomes the Kosmos. Inspired again, the Universe disappears into the bosom of the Great Mother, who then sleeps wrapped in her invisible robes.
device.what_is_ontological: Motion is one of three aspects of the Absolute. Abstract Space and Duration are the other two.
device.source: Theosophical material, supplied by Dlozi 23 September 2026.

device.name: The Believer
device.nature: A teaching device for how beliefs work. Not a claim about a literal creature and not a component of the ontology.
device.description: A creature that is a tool. Not good, not bad. Like a living toaster: it keeps itself alive and does what it does. What it is great at is holding on to frequencies.
device.mechanism: It leverages your own experiences in those frequencies to create a braid, which is easier to hold on to than singular vibrational strings. It uses the memories that are beneficial to it to reinforce holding on to a certain vibration.
device.use_case: You use a believer especially in a dense dimension, where you need to constantly hold on to the vibration of density and don't want to let go of it suddenly. You are playing with a lot of frequencies, like weaving with your fingers, holding some threads with some fingers while pulling others. You give the believer certain frequencies and say: hold on to these for me and reinforce them. "Make sure I hold on to this body."
device.neutrality: Whether a belief is positive or negative, the believer doesn't care. A toaster doesn't tell you it's toasting wrong. Neither does a believer.
device.why_letting_go_is_hard: It is not because of the negative beliefs. It is because the believer is just doing a job. "You said I must hold on to this. I didn't know this was bad. You said, I held on." So the work of letting go is required.

device.name: Paint and layers
device.description: Beliefs as colours of paint, and as layers in Photoshop. Three beliefs at red, green and blue, each at amplitude one, hold a third each. Raise blue to three and it holds three fifths, tinting the whole image. Nothing new appears; the mood changes greatly.
device.reading: Mixing, not coverage. Everything is here and now, so every part of the image carries every belief at once.

open_items.item: The ALL is Be-Ness: (Abstract Space x Abstract Motion) ^ Absolute. The Absolute has three aspects: Abstract Space, Abstract Motion and Duration. The formula as given names two of them, so where Duration sits in it is open. How any of this is expressed in the ontology is open.
Which rung Mental is inherited from, and whether Mental is something Self is or something Self has. Under discussion in the playground.
Self inherits createField() through Soul, so Self can create Fields. Confirm whether that is intended.
Whether a Belief, or any entity other than a Creator, has a reflection of its own.
The Art of Allowing needs restating now that the sliver framing is gone.

Java types are built on identity and exclusion: in a set or out of it, one class or another. Poles and gradients do not express cleanly that way. How far the code should go towards vectors and nearness is open.
Whether a thought reinforces only the belief holding its frequencies, or also nearby beliefs in proportion to nearness.

deferred_items.item: Monad, Atmic, Buddhic and Higher Self are placed but not developed.

working_rules.rule: Never build the ontology out of a narrative device. Metaphors explain; they are not components. If a class starts to look like a metaphor, it is wrong.
Ontology lives here. A domain never redefines a core class; it uses it. If a domain needs a new core part, that is a change to this file.
When the ontology does not cover something, ask Dlozi. Do not fill the gap with general spiritual, new age or manifestation teaching.
Use Dlozi's terms exactly: Belief, amplitude, Allowance, Field, Reflection, Creator, Mental, YCYOR. Do not swap in synonyms or AI vocabulary.
When asking Dlozi a question, ask it clean. Do not attach a suggested answer.
Style, voice, spelling, formatting and method follow dlozi_ai_preamble.xml.

artefacts.artefact: The ontology as Java, one class per file.
